CustomField.inlineHelpText: REQUIRED when Cache Policy is DECLARED_DEPENDENCIES, and must be empty otherwise. Comma-separated field paths the contributor reads beyond the quote and its lines, relative to the Quote - e.g. SBQQ__Account__r.Customer_Tier__c. Each is schema-validated at config load, so a renamed field fails loudly instead of dropping out of the hash. HASHING IS NOT INVALIDATION: nothing marks a quote Stale when an Account field changes; every launch must call generate-or-reuse.
CustomField.label: Contributor Dependency Set
